title: SensorDash · Cooling Systems
description: Cooling-focused read-only diagnostic dashboard. CPU/GPU heat-source temperatures are distinct from coolant; coolant temperature and flow are first-class trend charts. The separate advanced NEXT group is chemistry and device diagnostics only; absent ambient sensor remains optional.

options.content:
### LIQUID COOLING
Real tachometer and temperature readings · Windows owns physical fan control

panels.title: Radiator RPM
panels.description: Highest current RPM among assigned radiator fan groups. The source is the winning bound sensor, with SensorDash alias preferred and sensor name as fallback; this remains a read-only observation.

targets.expr: label_transform(label_transform((topk(1, (sensordash_reading_value{host=~"$host",kind="Fan"} * on(host,sensor) group_right() (sensordash_cooling_binding_value{host=~"$host",system=~"$system",kind="Fan",role=~"fan-group"} == 1)) * on(host,sensor) group_left(name,alias,device) (sensordash_sensor_info_value{host=~"$host"} == 1))) * on(host,sensor) group_left(display) (label_replace(sensordash_sensor_info_value{host=~"$host",kind="Fan",name!~"(?i).*(warning|critical).*",alias!="unassigned"} == 1, "display", "$1", "alias", "(.+)") or label_replace(sensordash_sensor_info_value{host=~"$host",kind="Fan",name!~"(?i).*(warning|critical).*",alias="unassigned"} == 1, "display", "$1", "name", "(.+)")), "display", "_+", " "), "display", "^ +| +$", "")

panels.title: DDC pump RPM
panels.description: Highest current pump tachometer value (not a PWM-controlled pump). The source is the winning bound sensor, with SensorDash alias preferred and sensor name as fallback; this remains a read-only observation.

targets.expr: label_transform(label_transform((topk(1, (sensordash_reading_value{host=~"$host",kind="Fan"} * on(host,sensor) group_right() (sensordash_cooling_binding_value{host=~"$host",system=~"$system",kind="Fan",role=~"pump"} == 1)) * on(host,sensor) group_left(name,alias,device) (sensordash_sensor_info_value{host=~"$host"} == 1))) * on(host,sensor) group_left(display) (label_replace(sensordash_sensor_info_value{host=~"$host",kind="Fan",name!~"(?i).*(warning|critical).*",alias!="unassigned"} == 1, "display", "$1", "alias", "(.+)") or label_replace(sensordash_sensor_info_value{host=~"$host",kind="Fan",name!~"(?i).*(warning|critical).*",alias="unassigned"} == 1, "display", "$1", "name", "(.+)")), "display", "_+", " "), "display", "^ +| +$", "")

panels.title: Radiator PWM
panels.description: Current control-duty sensor reading for the radiator fan group. The source is the winning bound sensor, with SensorDash alias preferred and sensor name as fallback; this remains a read-only observation.

targets.expr: label_transform(label_transform((topk(1, (sensordash_reading_value{host=~"$host",kind="Control"} * on(host,sensor) group_right() (sensordash_cooling_binding_value{host=~"$host",system=~"$system",kind="Control",role=~"fan-group"} == 1)) * on(host,sensor) group_left(name,alias,device) (sensordash_sensor_info_value{host=~"$host"} == 1))) * on(host,sensor) group_left(display) (label_replace(sensordash_sensor_info_value{host=~"$host",kind="Control",name!~"(?i).*(warning|critical).*",alias!="unassigned"} == 1, "display", "$1", "alias", "(.+)") or label_replace(sensordash_sensor_info_value{host=~"$host",kind="Control",name!~"(?i).*(warning|critical).*",alias="unassigned"} == 1, "display", "$1", "name", "(.+)")), "display", "_+", " "), "display", "^ +| +$", "")

options.content:
### COOLING TRENDS
Heat sources, radiator fans and fixed-speed pump · no interpolated sleep gaps

panels.title: CPU / GPU block temperatures
panels.description: Temperature readings assigned to heat-source components (CPU and GPU), excluding the separate coolant and ambient probes. Compare block temperatures against the dedicated coolant chart below. Samples are not interpolated.

panels.title: CPU / GPU heat-source power
panels.description: Measurements are recorded on Windows; cooling assignments remain controlled by SensorDash. Gaps are not filled. Series names come from the SensorDash sensor catalog; stable sensor IDs and the raw measurement values are unchanged. Alias/label changes do not rewrite archived samples. Visible name labels are normalized at query time; the stored series and join identity labels are unchanged.

panels.title: COOLANT CIRCULATION · installed sensors

options.content:
### ASSIGNMENT REFERENCE
Cooling relationships are edited in SensorDash; this inventory is read-only

panels.title: Sensor assignments · reference
panels.description: Current read-only assignments from SensorDash. Sensor names and aliases come from its sensor catalog; raw hardware IDs are hidden only in this table. This is metadata, not proof that every assigned sensor has recent measurements. Friendly labels are normalized at Grafana query time; the original measurement IDs remain unmodified.

panels.title: Coolant conductivity · µS/cm
panels.description: Conductivity measures dissolved-ion effects and additive chemistry; it does not directly test corrosion or pH.

panels.title: Manufacturer water-quality estimate
panels.description: Manufacturer-calculated percentage based on conductivity thresholds; not an independent chemical water-quality test.

panels.title: NEXT supply voltages
panels.description: USB/device supply voltage monitoring, recorded only when present.

panels.title: NEXT alarm state
panels.description: Native device alarm flags. 1 indicates an active NEXT alarm, 0 means inactive; gaps indicate no valid observation.

panels.title: Calculated heat dissipation · optional
panels.description: Estimated heat dissipation calculated by the NEXT when its required coolant temperature probes are available. No data is expected with an ambient-air probe or without the second coolant measurement.
